heading: Indoor golf in the Okanagan
title: Indoor Golf Simulators in the Okanagan | Okanagan Roam
description: Keep swinging after the courses close: Okanagan indoor golf simulators for 24/7 practice, lessons and club fitting, or a night out with friends.
intro: When the outdoor season winds down, you don't have to put the clubs away. The valley has a good spread of simulator spaces in Kelowna, West Kelowna, Vernon and Penticton.
Some are self-serve bays you can book at any hour, some are built around lessons and real swing data, and some are as much a night out as a round of golf.

items.name: The Fringe Indoor Golf
items.text: A 24/7, staffless simulator space off Lakeshore, where secure mobile access replaces a front desk. Four Trackman iO bays cover more than 300 virtual courses, with hourly rates and membership discounts.

items.name: Anytime Sim Golf
items.text: A fully automated simulator on Vaughan Avenue: book a private bay online and a CloudKey unlocks the door when you arrive. It runs day or night, 365 days a year, on Foresight Sports launch monitors.

items.name: GOLFBOX
items.text: Three private bays with Trackman iO technology in a boutique space of live-edge wood and warm lighting, open 24/7. An upstairs boardroom makes it work for corporate bookings too.

items.name: Back Nine Indoor Golf
items.text: Three roomy private bays on Full Swing technology, with a course library that includes Pebble Beach and St. Andrews. No membership is required to book a bay, and members get round-the-clock access.

items.name: Golf Evolution
items.text: GC Hawk simulators with tour-level club and ball data, plus lessons, club fitting and maintenance from a Canadian Certified PGA Professional. Credit-based Evo Packs can be shared with friends or family, and there's a lounge with food and drinks.

items.name: JSquared Golf
items.text: An instruction-focused operation on the Gallagher's Canyon property, with a GCQUAD launch monitor and PGA of Canada professionals teaching golfers of every level. Open daily from 8 a.m. to 10 p.m.

items.name: Predator Ridge SIM Lounge
items.text: A seasonal indoor golf spot that reopens each fall and runs through the winter, with Foresight launch monitors and more than 90 virtual courses. Bookings are by phone only, in one-hour blocks for up to four, and a PGA of Canada professional offers lessons.

items.name: Okanagan Virtual Golf
items.text: A Brewery District lounge with four bays and roughly 2,000 virtual courses, from Predator Ridge and Tower Ranch to Augusta. A fully licensed bar pours local craft beer, cocktails and mocktails, and there are organized leagues.

items.name: Okanagan Virtual Golf
items.text: A simulator lounge on Main Street with three bays, more than 400 virtual courses and a dedicated training bay. Lessons come from instructors connected to Summerland Golf Club, and winter scramble leagues run once the outdoor season ends.

items.name: Dante's Golf Lounge
items.text: The Rise's indoor golf spot, with two Foresight simulator bays, rental clubs and food and drinks from the restaurant next door. A winter scramble league adds some friendly competition.

items.name: Simplex Sportszone
items.text: Golf studios on Trackman 4 and Full Swing technology, with in-house PGA coaches, in a licensed building that also has simulators for hockey, baseball, soccer and more. Event hosting for groups of up to 40 makes it a go-to for birthdays and team outings.
